title: Heaven Tour
statementMd:
The story was not finished as PMP thought. God offered him one more chance to reincarnate and come back to life. But before he can come back, God told him that PMP should ask $*n*$ great men including prominent programmers about their life experiences.

The men are standing on a straight line. They are numbered $1$ through $*n*$ from left to right. The coordinate of the $*i*$-th man is $*x*_{*i*}$ $(*x*_{*i*} < *x*_{*i* + 1}, *i* < *n*)$. PMP should visit all these people one by one in arbitrary order. Each men should be visited **exactly once**. At the beginning of his tour, he starts at location of $*s*$-th man and asks him about his experiences.

Each time PMP wants to change his location, he should give a ticket to an angel and the angel carries him to his destination. Angels take PMP from one location, fly to his destination and put him down there. Nobody else is visited in this movement. Moving from $*i*$-th man to $*j*$-th man, takes $|*x*_{*i*} - *x*_{*j*}|$ time. PMP can get back to life as soon as he visits all men.

There are two types of angels: Some angels are going to the right and they only accept right tickets. Others are going the left and they only accept left tickets. There are an unlimited number of angels of each type. PMP has $*l*$ left tickets and $*n* - 1 - *l*$ right tickets.

PMP wants to get back to life as soon as possible to be able to compete in this year's final instead of the final he missed last year. He wants to know the quickest way to visit all the men exactly once. He also needs to know the exact sequence moves he should make.

## Input

The first line of input contains three space-separated integers $*n*, *l*, *s*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}, 0 ≤ *l* < *n*, 1 ≤ *s* ≤ *n*$) — the number of people to visit, the number left tickets PMP got, and initial location of PMP. Next line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers. The $*i*$-th integer in this line is $*x*_{*i*}$ ($0 = *x*_{1} < *x*_{2} < ... < *x*_{*n*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the location of $*i*$-th man.

## Output

If PMP cannot visit all men with the tickets he got print -1 in the only line of output. Otherwise, in the first line you should print the minimum time PMP can visit all men. In the second line you should print $*n* - 1$ integers that are the numbers of the men that PMP should visit in order in one optimal solution. If there are multiple answers, output any of them.

Please do not use the `%lld` specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use `cin`, `cout` streams or the `%I64d` specifier.

## Note

Let us remind here, a great contestant of all times, who left us about a year ago. May Renat Mullakhanov rest in peace.
statementZhMd:
故事并没有像 PMP 所想的那样结束。上帝又给了他一次转世重生的机会。但在他重返人世之前，上帝告诉他，PMP 应该向包括杰出程序员在内的 $*n*$ 位伟人请教他们的人生经历。

这些人站在一条直线上。从左到右编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。第 $*i*$ 个人的坐标为 $*x*_{*i*}$ $(*x*_{*i*} < *x*_{*i* + 1}, *i* < *n*)$。PMP 应该以任意顺序逐一拜访所有人。每个人都必须被**恰好拜访一次**。在旅程开始时，他位于第 $*s*$ 个人的位置，并向他询问人生经历。

每当 PMP 想要改变位置时，他都必须将一张票交给天使，由天使将他带到目的地。天使从一个位置接走 PMP，飞到目的地后将他放下。在这次移动过程中不会拜访其他人。
从第 $*i*$ 个人移动到第 $*j*$ 个人需要花费 $|*x*_{*i*} - *x*_{*j*}|$ 的时间。PMP 在拜访完所有人后即可重获新生。

天使有两种类型：一些天使向右飞，只接受向右的票；另一些天使向左飞，只接受向左的票。每种类型的天使都有无限多个。PMP 有 $*l*$ 张向左的票和 $*n* - 1 - *l*$ 张向右的票。

PMP 想尽快重获新生，以便参加今年的决赛，而不是参加去年错过的那场决赛。他想知道恰好拜访所有人的最快方式，并且还需要知道应当进行的确切移动顺序。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$、$*l*$、$*s*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}, 0 ≤ *l* < *n*, 1 ≤ *s* ≤ *n*$）——需要拜访的人数、PMP 获得的向左票数量，以及 PMP 的初始位置。下一行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数。该行中的第 $*i*$ 个整数为 $*x*_{*i*}$（$0 = *x*_{1} < *x*_{2} < ... < *x*_{*n*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——第 $*i*$ 个人的位置。

## 输出格式

如果 PMP 无法使用获得的票拜访所有人，则在唯一一行中输出 -1。否则，第一行输出 PMP 拜访所有人所需的最短时间。第二行输出 $*n* - 1$ 个整数，表示在某个最优方案中 PMP 应按何种顺序拜访这些人。如果有多个答案，输出任意一个即可。

请不要在 С++ 中使用 `%lld` 格式说明符来读写 64 位整数。建议使用 `cin`、`cout` 流，或使用 `%I64d` 格式说明符。

## 说明

让我们在此缅怀一位历来最伟大的参赛者，他在大约一年前离开了我们。愿 Renat Mullakhanov 安息。
